name: At what point in the remodel should the kitchen backsplash be installed?

mainEntity.name: At what point in the remodel should the kitchen backsplash be installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tile backsplashes should be installed after your countertops are permanently set and leveled. Installing the countertop first creates a stable, horizontal reference ledge from which tile layout can begin. If backsplash tile is installed beforehand, variations in countertop thickness or wall levelness can leave uneven gaps that are difficult to seal neatly with silicone or grout. Setting the stone or solid-surface counter first ensures that the tile, whether marble subway tile or intricate mosaic, rests flush against the counter edge for a clean, watertight seal along the back wall.
acceptedAnswer.description: The backsplash should always be installed after countertops are secured in place, ensuring a level starting base and a tight, watertight seal along the counter.
